scope: repository index only; no candidate installation, execution, cloning, or skill-body curation
collection_notes: Local main, origin/main, and origin/zh were compared case-insensitively by full_name before admission; no accepted candidate was already indexed.
GitHub public metadata supplied repository IDs and Stars snapshots; commit-pinned public archives supplied README/tree/SKILL/license evidence without running candidate code.
Skill counts distinguish public distributable SKILL.md entries from MCP tools, templates, fixtures, compatibility copies, plugin metadata, and dataset rows.
License evidence was checked at the candidate repository level; corpus records retain upstream license boundaries and is explicitly indexed as a dataset rather than an installer.
Forks, mirrors, no-license candidates, and stale compatibility copies were excluded.
